Top Typing Speeds Query
code:
SELECT u.username, MAX(t.wpm) AS top_wpm, AVG(t.accuracy) AS avg_acc
FROM users u
JOIN test_results t ON u.id = t.user_id
WHERE t.mode = 'time 60'
GROUP BY u.id, u.username
ORDER BY top_wpm DESC
LIMIT 10;
